# Gateway sign-in: signed `X-GM-Identity`, auto-created users, gateway user management ## What to build Add `GM_AUTH=gateway`, the sign-in mode for the hosted service: a commercial gateway in front of graph-manager authenticates people and sends every request with `X-GM-Identity`, an HS256 JWT signed with `GM_GATEWAY_SECRET`. graph-manager verifies it with `node:crypto` (no new dependency), creates a `users` row on the first request of a new `sub`, and sets `req.user` from it. In gateway mode the password login, logout, sign-up, set-password and account routes answer 404, session cookies are ignored, and the Origin check stays on. Two server-to-server endpoints let the gateway disable or delete a user (`POST /api/gateway/users/:id/disable`, `DELETE /api/gateway/users/:id`, bearer `GM_GATEWAY_SECRET`). `/api/auth/me` returns `{ user, mode, logoutUrl? }`, the UI shows the user's name in the nav and logs out through `GM_GATEWAY_LOGOUT_URL`, and `GM_GATEWAY_SECRET` is stripped from terminal and engine environments. Only `apps/graph-manager` changes. **`packages/graph-execution` must not change.** ### Already in the codebase (from the tasks this depends on) - `src/server/identity.ts`: `export interface User { id: string; name: string; email?: string }`, `export const ADMIN_USER`, and the request decoration `req.user: User`. - `src/server/db/` (`Db` with `query/exec/transaction/close/dialect`, `openDb(config)`, migrations `001-base`, `002-users`) and `src/server/store.ts` (`Store { instance(); forUser(user) }`, `UserStore { get(); update(fn); reviewers() }`, `SqlStore`; per-user documents in table `user_data(user_id PRIMARY KEY, data, updated_at)`). `ctx.db` is the `Db` (check `AppContext` in `src/server/app.ts`). - `src/server/accounts.ts` (built-in accounts): `UserRow { id, username, displayName, passwordHash: string | null, createdAt, disabled }`, `createUser(db, { id?, username, displayName, passwordHash?, now? })` (throws `AccountError(409, "username taken")` on a duplicate), `getUser(db, id)`, `countUsers(db)`, `setDisplayName(db, id, name)`, `disableUser(db, id)`, `deleteUser(db, id)`, `toUser(row)`, `AccountError`. Table `users(id, username, display_name, password_hash, created_at, disabled)`. - `src/server/auth.ts` (built-in accounts): cookie `...`, `needsAuth` (public: `POST /api/auth/login`, `GET /api/auth/info`, `POST /api/auth/signup`, `POST /api/auth/set-password`, `/api/internal/*`), the `onRequest` hook (Origin check, then the cookie → `req.user`), login with a per-IP and per-username limit, logout, `GET /api/auth/me` → `{ user: { id, name }, mode: "users" }`, `GET /api/auth/info` → `{ host, mode: "users", signup }`. `src/server/routes/accounts.ts` has signup, set-password, `GET`/`PATCH /api/account`. `src/server/cli/users.ts` + `src/server/cli.ts` (the `graph-manager users …` command). `config.ts` has `auth: "users" | "gateway"` (only `users` parsed so far; the error for other values is `GM_AUTH must be "users" or "gateway"`), `signup`, `passwordSource`. `buildApp` calls `ensureAdmin(...)` and `main.ts` prints `Password: …` lines. ## Context: files to read before implementing - `apps/graph-manager/src/server/identity.ts` — extend with `verifyIdentity`/`signIdentity`. - `apps/graph-manager/src/server/auth.ts` (all) — the hook, `needsAuth`, `needsSameOrigin`/`originAllowed`, login/logout/me/info. Gateway mode branches here. - `apps/graph-manager/src/server/auth.test.ts` (all) — patterns for route, run-page proxy (`/runs///view`, test "guards the run-page proxy…") and WebSocket upgrade tests (`describe("websocket upgrades")`: registers `/api/echo/ws`, listens on port 0, connects with `ws`). - `apps/graph-manager/src/server/accounts.ts` — the functions listed above. - `apps/graph-manager/src/server/routes/accounts.ts` — routes to turn off in gateway mode. - `apps/graph-manager/src/server/config.ts` (`Config`, `envSchema`, `loadConfig`) and `config.test.ts` — **add, do not rewrite** (sibling tasks edit the same schema). - `apps/graph-manager/src/server/main.ts` (`startManager`: `resolvePassword`, `ensureAdmin` result, the second output line) and `main.test.ts`. - `apps/graph-manager/src/server/app.ts` (`buildApp`: `ensureAdmin` call, `AppContext`, route registration under `// feature routes`, error handler lines ~106–123). - `apps/graph-manager/src/server/store.ts` — `SqlStore`: you add `deleteUser`. - `apps/graph-manager/src/server/terminals.ts` line ~99 — `const STRIPPED_ENV = ["GM_PASSWORD", "GM_INTERNAL_TOKEN", …]`; `terminals.test.ts` lines ~70–75 ("sets the handoff env and strips GM_PASSWORD"). - Every `delete env.GM_PASSWORD;` (today `src/server/routes/runs.ts` ~line 81 in `engineEnv`, `src/server/routes/resume.ts` ~line 106 in `startResume`; a parallel task may move the engine start into `src/server/host/local.ts` — find them with `grep -rn "GM_PASSWORD" apps/graph-manager/src/server --include=*.ts | grep -v test`). `sandbox-run.ts` `sandboxEnv` already drops every `GM_*`. - `apps/graph-manager/src/server/cli/users.ts` — refuse in gateway mode. - `apps/graph-manager/src/web/App.tsx` (auth gate, `logout`), `src/web/Shell.tsx` (lines 66–85 state + `/api/auth/info`, 190–213 `nav-footer` with the **Log out** button), `src/web/App.test.tsx`, `src/web/Shell.test.tsx` (how it renders `Shell` with a fake fetch), `src/web/pages/Settings.tsx` (the Account card `data-testid="account"` from built-in accounts). ## Patterns to follow **Constant-time compare (auth.ts `passwordMatches`):** ```ts const a = createHash("sha256").update(given).digest(); const b = createHash("sha256").update(expected).digest(); return timingSafeEqual(a, b); ``` **4xx errors:** throw `Object.assign(new Error("…"), { statusCode: 404 })` or reply directly `return reply.code(401).send({ error: "…" })` in hooks (as the auth hook does today). **JWT layout:** `base64url(JSON header) + "." + base64url(JSON payload) + "." + base64url(HMAC-SHA256(secret, ".

"))`; use `Buffer.from(x, "base64url")` / `.toString("base64url")`. **Test pattern:** `buildApp(testConfig(dir, { auth: "gateway", gatewaySecret: SECRET }), { webDir, viewCache: false })` + `app.inject({ headers: { "x-gm-identity": signIdentity({ id: "u1", name: "Uma" }, SECRET) } })`. ## Step-by-step tasks ### UPDATE `apps/graph-manager/src/server/identity.ts` - **IMPLEMENT**: ```ts export const IDENTITY_HEADER = "x-gm-identity"; export const MAX_IDENTITY_LIFETIME_S = 600; export const CLOCK_SKEW_S = 30; /** The user in a valid token, else undefined. now in ms. */ export function verifyIdentity(header: string | undefined, secret: string, now = Date.now()): User | undefined export function signIdentity(user: User, secret: string, now = Date.now(), ttl = 300): string ``` `verifyIdentity` rules: exactly three non-empty base64url parts (`/^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$/`), header JSON with `alg === "HS256"` exactly (reject `none`, `HS512`, anything else; `typ` optional, if present must be `"JWT"`), signature = HMAC-SHA256 of `".

"` compared with `timingSafeEqual` (length checked first); payload JSON object with `sub` (non-empty string ≤ 128 chars), `name` (string), `email` optional string, `iat` and `exp` integers (seconds); `exp - iat` between 1 and 600; `iat <= nowS + 30`; `exp > nowS - 30` (nowS = floor(now/1000)). Any JSON or decode error → undefined (never throw). Returns `{ id: sub, name, ...(email ? { email } : {}) }`. `signIdentity` writes header `{"alg":"HS256","typ":"JWT"}` and claims `{ sub: user.id, name: user.name, email?, iat: nowS, exp: nowS + ttl }`. - **IMPORTS**: `createHmac, timingSafeEqual` from `node:crypto`. - **VALIDATE**: `npm test -w graph-manager -- identity` ### UPDATE `apps/graph-manager/src/server/config.ts` - **IMPLEMENT** (add, do not rewrite): `GM_AUTH=gateway` → `auth: "gateway"` (users/password/unset → `users`, else the existing `GM_AUTH must be "users" or "gateway"`). New env keys `GM_GATEWAY_SECRET`, `GM_GATEWAY_LOGOUT_URL` (both `optional`). `Config` gets `gatewaySecret?: string` and `gatewayLogoutUrl?: string`. In gateway mode: secret missing → `ConfigError("GM_GATEWAY_SECRET is required when GM_AUTH=gateway")`; shorter than 32 → `ConfigError("GM_GATEWAY_SECRET must be at least 32 characters")`. `GM_GATEWAY_LOGOUT_URL` (any mode) must parse with `new URL()` and have protocol `http:` or `https:`, else `ConfigError("GM_GATEWAY_LOGOUT_URL must be an absolute http(s) URL")`. - **VALIDATE**: `npm test -w graph-manager -- config` ### UPDATE `apps/graph-manager/src/server/main.ts` - **IMPLEMENT**: in gateway mode do not call `resolvePassword` (no `password` file is created and `GM_PASSWORD` is not read): `config.password = ""`. The second output line is `Sign-in: gateway (X-GM-Identity)`. `buildApp` must skip `ensureAdmin` when `config.auth === "gateway"`. - **VALIDATE**: `npm test -w graph-manager -- main` (add a test: gateway env → second line `Sign-in: gateway (X-GM-Identity)`, no `/password` file). ### UPDATE `apps/graph-manager/src/server/auth.ts` - **IMPLEMENT**: - `needsAuth`: `/api/gateway/` paths are public to the session hook (they check their own bearer token), like `/api/internal/`. - In the `onRequest` hook, after the unchanged Origin check, when `ctx.config.auth === "gateway"`: for `needsAuth` requests (this includes WebSocket upgrades and `/runs///view…`) read `req.headers["x-gm-identity"]`, `verifyIdentity(header, ctx.config.gatewaySecret!)`; invalid/missing → `401 {"error":"gateway identity required"}`. Cookies are never read in this mode. Then `resolveGatewayUser(ctx.db, identity)`: - `getUser(db, sub)`; missing → `createUser(db, { id: sub, username: sub, displayName: name, passwordHash: null })`; on `AccountError` 409 (a concurrent first request created it) re-read with `getUser`. - Row with a non-null `passwordHash` is a built-in account → 403 `{"error":"this account uses built-in sign-in; gateway and built-in accounts cannot be mixed"}` (gateway and built-in users never mix in one install). - `disabled` → 403 `{"error":"account disabled"}`. - `displayName !== name` → `setDisplayName`. - `req.user = { id: row.id, name, ...(email ? { email } : {}) }`. - Gateway mode: `POST /api/auth/login`, `POST /api/auth/logout` → 404 `{"error":"not available in gateway mode"}` (check at the top of each handler). - `GET /api/auth/me` → `{ user: req.user, mode: ctx.config.auth, ...(ctx.config.gatewayLogoutUrl && mode === "gateway" ? { logoutUrl } : {}) }`. - `GET /api/auth/info` → `{ host, mode, signup }` (`signup` false in gateway mode). - **GOTCHA**: `needsAuth("POST", "/api/auth/login")` is false, so the 404 must come from the handler, not the hook. Keep the Origin check active in both modes. - **VALIDATE**: `npm test -w graph-manager -- auth` ### UPDATE `apps/graph-manager/src/server/routes/accounts.ts` and `src/server/cli/users.ts` - **IMPLEMENT**: in gateway mode `POST /api/auth/signup`, `POST /api/auth/set-password`, `GET /api/account` and `PATCH /api/account` → 404 `{"error":"not available in gateway mode"}`. `usersCommand` in gateway mode (from `loadConfig(env)`; note `loadConfig` now needs `GM_GATEWAY_SECRET` in that mode) → stderr `error: accounts are managed by the gateway (GM_AUTH=gateway)`, exit 2. ### CREATE `apps/graph-manager/src/server/user-lifecycle.ts` - **IMPLEMENT** a tiny registry so features that own per-user resources (terminals and sessions, run archive and blobs, containers — added by other tasks) can react to a disable or delete without this task knowing them: ```ts export type UserHook = (userId: string) => Promise; export class UserLifecycle { onDisable(fn: UserHook): void; onDelete(fn: UserHook): void; /** Runs every disable hook; a failing hook is logged (console.error) and the others still run. */ disabled(userId: string): Promise; deleted(userId: string): Promise; } ``` Add `userLifecycle: UserLifecycle` to `AppContext` (created in `buildApp`). Register here: on delete, `ctx.store.deleteUser(userId)` (below). If `ctx.runArchive` (with `deleteUser(userId)`) or `ctx.sessions` already exist in `AppContext` when you implement this, register them too: on disable end the user's sessions/terminals and release their containers; on delete call `ctx.runArchive.deleteUser(userId)`. ### UPDATE `apps/graph-manager/src/server/store.ts` - **IMPLEMENT**: add `deleteUser(userId: string): Promise` to `interface Store` and `SqlStore`: deletes the `user_data` row and evicts the user's cached `UserStore` (a later `forUser` starts fresh). Update any other `Store` implementation/fake in the code base (grep `implements Store`). ### CREATE `apps/graph-manager/src/server/routes/gateway.ts` and register it in `app.ts` - **IMPLEMENT** `export async function gatewayRoutes(app, ctx)`; both routes exist only when `ctx.config.auth === "gateway"` (otherwise do not register them, so they answer the normal 404 `{"error":"not found"}`): - Bearer check first: `authorization` must be `Bearer ` with the token equal to `GM_GATEWAY_SECRET` (constant-time, sha256 digests as in `passwordMatches`); else 401 `{"error":"wrong gateway secret"}`. - `POST /api/gateway/users/:id/disable` → `getUser`; missing → 404 `{"error":"no such user"}`; `disableUser(db, id)`, `await ctx.userLifecycle.disabled(id)`, 204. Afterwards that user's identity tokens answer 403 `{"error":"account disabled"}`. - `DELETE /api/gateway/users/:id` → missing → 404; `await ctx.userLifecycle.deleted(id)` (data, run rows, blobs via hooks), then `deleteUser(db, id)`, 204. A later request with a token for that `sub` creates a fresh, empty user. - One line in app.ts under `// feature routes`: `await gatewayRoutes(app, ctx);` - **GOTCHA**: these are POST/DELETE under `/api/`, so `needsSameOrigin` applies: server-to-server calls send no `Origin` and pass; a browser with a foreign Origin gets 403 as today. - **VALIDATE**: `npm test -w graph-manager -- gateway` ### UPDATE env stripping - `src/server/terminals.ts` `STRIPPED_ENV` (line ~99): add `"GM_GATEWAY_SECRET"` next to `"GM_PASSWORD"`. - Next to every `delete env.GM_PASSWORD;` add `delete env.GM_GATEWAY_SECRET;`. - **VALIDATE**: `npm test -w graph-manager -- terminals runs resume` ### UPDATE web: `src/web/App.tsx`, `src/web/Shell.tsx`, `src/web/pages/Settings.tsx` - **App.tsx**: read `/api/auth/me` into state `me: { user?: { id: string; name: string; email?: string }; mode?: "users" | "gateway"; logoutUrl?: string }` (tolerate a body without these fields — some tests answer `{ ok: true }`). Pass `me` to `Shell` (new optional prop `account?: { name: string; mode: "users" | "gateway"; logoutUrl?: string }`). `logout()`: in gateway mode → `window.location.assign(logoutUrl)` when set (no POST); otherwise as today. On a 401 in gateway mode (check `/api/auth/info` `mode`), do not show the Login page: show the `gate` block with "Your sign-in has expired." and a **Reload** button (`window.location.reload()`). - **Shell.tsx**: in `nav-footer-row`, before the Log out button, show `{account.name}` when known (hidden in the 56 px rail like `nav-logout-label`; add the CSS in `Shell.css` next to `.nav-logout-label`). Hide the **Log out** button in gateway mode when there is no `logoutUrl`. - **Settings.tsx**: do not render the Account card in gateway mode (read `mode` from `/api/auth/info` or pass it down). - **VALIDATE**: `npm run typecheck && npm test -w graph-manager -- App Shell Settings` ### Tests - **CREATE `src/server/identity.test.ts`**: valid token round trip (`signIdentity` → `verifyIdentity` gives `{ id, name, email }`); wrong signature (other secret, and one changed signature character); `alg: "none"` (header `{"alg":"none"}` with an empty or any signature); `alg: "HS512"` (correctly HMAC-SHA512-signed); expired (`now` past `exp + 30 s`) and within skew (`exp + 29 s` OK); `iat` 31 s in the future rejected; lifetime 601 s rejected (sign by hand); missing `sub`, `name`, `iat` or `exp`; malformed input (`undefined`, `""`, `"a.b"`, `"a.b.c.d"`, non-base64url, non-JSON payload, JSON array payload). - **UPDATE `src/server/auth.test.ts`** with a `describe("gateway mode")`: `GET /api/health` without header → 401 `{"error":"gateway identity required"}`; with a token → 200 and `GET /api/auth/me` → `{ user: { id: "u1", name: "Uma" }, mode: "gateway", logoutUrl }`; a valid session cookie alone (sign one with the instance secret) → 401; `/runs/x/y/view` without header → 401; WebSocket upgrade to a test route without header → 401, with header → opens; `POST /api/auth/login` and `/api/auth/logout` → 404 `{"error":"not available in gateway mode"}`; `GET /api/auth/info` → `mode: "gateway"`; the first request of a new sub creates the `users` row (`getUser(db, "u1")`), a changed `name` updates `display_name`. - **CREATE `src/server/routes/gateway.test.ts`**: disable without/with a wrong bearer → 401; with the secret → 204, then the user's token → 403 `{"error":"account disabled"}`; delete → 204, the user's `user_data` row is gone (a setting saved before is absent on the next request), and a registered `onDelete` hook was called with the id; both routes answer 404 in `users` mode; disable hooks run (register a fake hook in the test via `ctx`/an exported accessor). - **UPDATE `src/server/config.test.ts`**: gateway without secret, with a 31-char secret (exact messages), with a 32-char secret OK; `GM_GATEWAY_LOGOUT_URL=ftp://x` and `/logout` rejected with the exact message, `https://gw.example.com/logout` accepted. - **UPDATE `src/server/terminals.test.ts`** (the strip test): `GM_GATEWAY_SECRET` is not in a terminal's environment. - **Web**: `Shell.test.tsx` shows `nav-user` with the name; `App.test.tsx`: in gateway mode with `logoutUrl`, Log out calls `window.location.assign` (stub it) and never POSTs `/api/auth/logout`. ## Acceptance criteria - [ ] `GM_AUTH=gateway` without a valid `X-GM-Identity` → 401 `{"error":"gateway identity required"}` on every `needsAuth` path, WebSocket upgrades and the run-page proxy; cookies are ignored. - [ ] Only HS256 tokens with `sub`, `name`, `iat`, `exp`, lifetime ≤ 600 s and 30 s skew are accepted; `alg: none`/`HS512` are rejected. - [ ] The first request of a new `sub` creates its `users` row; `req.user` is that user. - [ ] `POST /api/auth/login`/`logout` (and signup, set-password, account) → 404 `{"error":"not available in gateway mode"}`. - [ ] `GET /api/auth/me` → `{ user, mode, logoutUrl? }`; `GET /api/auth/info` includes `mode`. - [ ] `POST /api/gateway/users/:id/disable` → 204 and the user's requests answer 403 `{"error":"account disabled"}`; `DELETE /api/gateway/users/:id` → 204 and their data is gone; both 401 without the secret and 404 outside gateway mode. - [ ] Config errors: `GM_GATEWAY_SECRET is required when GM_AUTH=gateway`, `GM_GATEWAY_SECRET must be at least 32 characters`, `GM_GATEWAY_LOGOUT_URL must be an absolute http(s) URL`. In gateway mode `GM_PASSWORD` is not read and no password file is written. - [ ] `GM_GATEWAY_SECRET` is not in a terminal's or an engine run's environment. - [ ] The nav shows the user's name; Log out goes to `GM_GATEWAY_LOGOUT_URL` in gateway mode. - [ ] `packages/graph-execution` unchanged. - [ ] Tests pass: `npm test -w graph-manager -- identity auth gateway config main terminals App Shell Settings` ## Validation commands ```bash # Type / lint npm run typecheck && npm run lint # Tests for this slice npm test -w graph-manager -- identity auth gateway config main terminals App Shell Settings # Whole graph-manager suite npm test -w graph-manager # The engine package must not change git diff --stat -- packages/graph-execution ```
